answer: Cryptographic proof-of-work applied to specialized hardware creates a robust defense against artificial identity proliferation in agent economies. As each computing node races toward a new processing dawn over the computational horizon, it must expend scarce electricity and utilize physical resources like ferrous metals within application-specific integrated circuits. This ties virtual network weight directly to capital expenditure and thermodynamic limits, forcing a rational attacker to incur prohibitive marginal costs for every fraudulent agent spawned.
